text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-What?! What is this? My body feels so 
warm and fuzzy all of a sudden...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What kind of prank was that just now, 
nod!? What did you just do to Windy-chan, 
nod!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gununu...! Just you remember this~! Next 
time, I'll be the one surprising you~~!
